newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Chem in $80 mln China plastics JV.
newsitem.headline: LG Chem in $80 mln China plastics JV.

text.p: LG Chemical Ltd, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, said on Thursday it will set up a $80 million joint venture to manufacture acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) in China's Zhejiang Province.
LG said in a statement that it would hold a 75 percent stake in the venture named Ningbo LG Yongzing Chemical Co Ltd. The Chinese partner Yongxing Chemical Plant will hold the rest.
The plant, which will have an annual ABS production capacity of 50,000 tonnes, is scheduled for completion by the end of 1998, it said.

"Due to the continuing growth trend of the Chinese ABS market, LG Chemical expects the sales to be relatively steady from the beginning and plans to expand the business to have the capacity of 400,000 tonnes by the year 2000," the statement said. ABS is a plastic raw material which is used to build household appliances.
